passage:
Every morning before school, Mrs. Liu cleaned the hallway. Most students walked past her without saying anything.
One day, a student slipped on spilled milk. Mrs. Liu quickly helped clean it before anyone else fell.
The student council decided to interview her for the school newspaper. They learned that she arrived at school earlier than most teachers and knew which classrooms were always neat or messy.
After the article was published, more students greeted her.
Mrs. Liu said the work had not changed, but the mornings felt different.
The school had always depended on her. It simply took one article for students to see work that was usually invisible.
